faq.title: Frequently Asked Questions
faq.description: Everything you need to know about Paperflow.

items.question: Who is Paperflow for?
items.answer: Paperflow is designed for professionals who manage complex documents. It is built for academics, lawyers, technical writers and authors who need absolute control over their revision history.

items.question: Do you use my writing to train AI?
items.answer: No. We do not use your text to train artificial intelligence models. Your work remains private and is never used to feed our algorithms.

items.question: Why use Markdown?
items.answer: We use Markdown to ensure formatting never becomes a distraction. You focus purely on structure and content while writing, but can export to any styled format (PDF, Word, LaTeX) when you are ready to publish.

items.question: What platforms will be supported?
items.answer: Paperflow will initially launch as a web application optimized for desktop browsers. This allows us to deliver updates quickly before expanding to native desktop or mobile applications.

items.question: How do I take my data out?
items.answer: Data ownership is a fundamental principle. You will be able to export your individual documents or your entire repository to standard formats like Markdown, Docx or PDF at any time.

items.question: How is this different from Google Docs?
items.answer: Google Docs is designed for live collaboration, which often results in a messy history. Paperflow is designed for version control, providing a clean and permanent record of every major decision you make.

items.question: Do I need technical skills to use it?
items.answer: No. While the technology is powerful, the interface is simple. We use concepts like 'Save Version' and 'Explore Idea' so you get the benefits of version control without needing to be a developer.

items.question: Is there a limit to how many versions I can save?
items.answer: We plan to offer unlimited version history. We believe your history is a valuable asset, not a storage problem that needs to be deleted.

items.question: Is this just Git for writers?
items.answer: It shares the same philosophy as Git (branching, merging, history), but the interface and features are built specifically for writing, legal texts and academic writing.

items.question: When can I start using Paperflow?
items.answer: Paperflow is currently in active development. We are opening access in waves to ensure stability. Join the waitlist to secure your place for the first public release.
